answer: The lantern schedule is applied in comet and nebula exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3621 identities would post 1038 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
